comment: Sony, Nothing, ASUS, vivo, Tecno, Infinix, itel, Nokia/HMD, Lenovo, ZTE: Prune relies on the community data and the generic rules for these brands. Only packages that are known to matter are listed here.

com.iqoo.secure.note: vivo i Manager: security, permissions and data usage.

com.asus.mobilemanager.note: ASUS Mobile Manager: permissions and battery management.

com.transsion.phonemaster.note: Phone Master: cleaning, battery and permission management on Tecno, Infinix and itel.

com.vivo.browser.note: vivo Browser. Make sure another browser is installed.
